ok.de: Well steht direkt hinter may und macht den Wechsel durchaus möglich: may well switch.
ok.en: Well stands right after may and makes the switch quite possible: may well switch.

wrong.de: Zwischen may und well steht kein be.
wrong.en: There is no be between may and well.

wrong.de: Good verstärkt hier nichts, es braucht well.
wrong.en: Good strengthens nothing here, it needs well.
After might there is no to.

ok.en: With at the moment you need the continuous: are rising.

wrong.de: Die einfache Form passt nicht zu at the moment.
wrong.en: The simple form does not fit at the moment.

wrong.de: Prices ist Plural, deshalb nicht rises.
wrong.en: Prices is plural, so not rises.

ok.de: Ein Plan von damals braucht were going to.
ok.en: A plan from back then needs were going to.

wrong.en: Went to means “walked to”, not “planned to”.

wrong.de: Would to ist keine feste Form.
wrong.en: Would to is not a fixed form.

ok.de: Nach bound steht to und die Grundform: bound to be.
ok.en: After bound comes to and the base form: bound to be.

wrong.en: bound for means “heading to”, but a base form follows here.

wrong.de: at passt nicht vor eine Grundform, es braucht to.
wrong.en: at does not fit before a base form, it needs to.

wrong.de: on passt nicht vor eine Grundform, es braucht to.
wrong.en: on does not fit before a base form, it needs to.

ok.en: After about comes to and the base form: about to leave.

wrong.en: for does not go with about, to + base form follows here.

wrong.en: about of does not exist, it is about to.

wrong.en: about at does not exist, it is about to.
